'Paratypes' 'INDIA • 2 ♂♂ adult; same data as for holotype; MZMU 3791, MZMU 3792 • 2 ♀♀ adult; same data as for holotype MZMU 3793, MZMU 3794 (Figs 7, 8B–D).' Table 3 caption (p. 286): 'Table 3 (continued on next page). Morphometrical and meristical data of Cyrtodactylus jayadityai sp. nov. from North Tripura, northeast India. Abbreviations: see Material and methods (NA stands for Not available).' Header 'Parameters | MZMU3791 | MZMU3792 | MZMU3793 | MZMU3794 | MZMU3795'; Status 'Paratype | Paratype | Paratype | Paratype | Holotype'; SEX 'M | M | F | F | M'; SVL '54.9 | 47.8 | 50.6 | 50.4 | 50.9'; HL '16.3 | 15.6 | 15.4 | 15.6 | 15.4'; OD '4.0 | 4.0 | 4.0 | 4.0 | 4.0'; OE '4.4 | 4.4 | 4.5 | 4.4 | 4.4'. All five specimens print OD 4.0. Holotype Head sentence (not used as the value; over 40 words) contains '[…] eye slightly more than a quarter of the head length (OD/HL 0.26); […] orbit to ear distance is slightly greater than the eye diameter (OE/OD 1.1); […]': 4.0/15.4 = 0.26 and 4.4/4.0 = 1.1 agree with the holotype column. The Variation section prints no OD value ('Please refer to Table 3 and Fig. 6 for variations within the new species.'). The quote is the whole OD row with cells joined by single spaces; the value logged is the cell under this specimen's column. Anatomy of preserved specimens; vision not tested.

note: Orbit diameter, not eye diameter: the Methods define OD only as 'OD = orbit diameter taken horizontally between the external eyeball borders;' and print no eye-diameter entry, so this is logged as sensory_anatomy under desk precedent (Cyrtodactylus nebulicola, desk-d476; Eublepharis jhuma, desk-d353) rather than eye_diameter_mm (audit 966 moved it). The holotype description does call OD 'the eye diameter' once ('OE/OD 1.1'); if the desk reads that as a definition, eye_diameter_mm with value 4.0 would follow. Table 3 prints no unit; mm from the Methods sentence quoted under method.
